products.title: Our Lady of Guadalupe Copper Ring with Colored Zircons
products.summary: This unisex stacked ring presents a retro Our Lady of Guadalupe motif, with micro-inlaid colored zircons set on a copper-toned alloy band. The stacked design allows casual layering, while the Marian image fits a Catholic devotional wardrobe.
products.description:
The ring's centered design depicts Our Lady of Guadalupe in a retro style, with micro-inlaid colored zircons adding a subtle shimmer. The copper-toned alloy band is finished to resist fading, and its stacked silhouette suits mix-and-match styling on multiple fingers.

Useful as a personal devotional accessory or as a small gift for occasions such as First Communion or baptism, this ring carries a recognizable Marian image without being overtly ornate. The unisex fit and durable construction make it suitable for everyday wear, while the religious motif keeps it at home in Catholic gift settings.

The product facts specify a cross-shaped pattern; the image of Our Lady of Guadalupe is associated with the cross, though a plain cross is not depicted. The ring is offered as a single item within the Religious style category.
products.catholicContext: Our Lady of Guadalupe is a title for the Virgin Mary, venerated in Catholic tradition.

products.title: Plastic Our Lady Pendant Ornament in Five Variants
products.summary: A plastic pendant ornament featuring Our Lady, available in five variants (01–05). Suitable for home decoration, this piece brings a Marian accent to Catholic-themed spaces.
products.description:
This Our Lady pendant ornament shows the Virgin Mary in a compact plastic form, offered in five variants (01–05) so you can choose the finish that fits your decor. The piece is designed as a hanging decoration, meant to be displayed in a home or similar setting.

The ornament's plastic construction keeps it lightweight, and its small scale suits placement on a wall, shelf, or niche. Each variant offers a distinct visual take on the same Marian subject, giving you flexibility when sourcing for retail or personal use.

Because the source lists it under 'Ornaments' and describes it as an atmosphere decoration, treat it as a devotional accessory rather than a liturgical item. It is not described as blessed or consecrated, and no such claim is implied here.

products.description:
This keychain combines a round wooden pendant with a hemp rope tassel for a classic, pastoral look. The wood material and hemp rope technique ensure durability and a natural feel, while the round shape and circle pattern offer a timeless design. It is reusable, making it a practical accessory for daily use or as a decorative hanging piece.

Sourced from CN;ZHE, this keychain is positioned as a decorative pendant suitable for hanging on bags, keys, or as an ornament. Its classic style and neutral design make it a versatile choice for various events such as holidays, birthdays, weddings, and more.
